avis.titre: Good glow but not for me
avis.texte: I really wanted to love this product because it gave my skin a beautiful, healthy glow. Unfortunately, it wasn't the right fit for me. It left a sticky feeling on my skin that never seemed to fully absorb, and I found that it didn't wear well under my makeup. While it may work well for others, it just didn't suit my skin or my routine. I did appreciate the glow it provided, but because of the texture, I won't be repurchasing.
I used this one time before bed and woke up with several red bumps on my face. Possibly an allergic reaction? I didn't use it after that and returned it. I do have sensitive skin.

I switched over to this after years of using TO's 10% Niacinamide+Zinc which began to burn and irritate my skin. This has a lower concentration at 5% and helps maintain my skin's even texture while leaving it glowing and looking healthy. Worth a try!

avis.titre: Adds a nice glow to my sensitive skin
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin and products can be hit or miss. More seem to be on the miss side. My skin seems to really like this product. It dries lightweight and gives a beautiful glow. I will be repurchasing again once I run out.

Hyper sensitive skin, food, weather, clothing, smell (yes strong smells can cause my face to break out) and especially face care to include makeup and skin care. Anua products are made for people like me that once your ph gets messed up from contact dermatitis, its upwards of a month to settle down.
